newsitem.title: USA: NYPA confirms Fitzpatrick, N.Y. nuke plant restart.
newsitem.headline: NYPA confirms Fitzpatrick, N.Y. nuke plant restart.

text.p: New York Power Authority (NYPA) confirmed Friday its James A Fitzpatrick nuclear power plant resumed electricity production following a scheduled refueling and maintenance outage.
The unit was shut Oct 26 for 47 days of maintenance, the company said in a statement.
Earlier Friday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said the plant was producing at 20 percent of capacity and was increasing power.
During the shutdown the plant was modified to boost power output to a maximum of 832 megawatts, NYPA said in the statement.
The plant, in Scriba, N.Y., will operate for about two years before the next refueling, the company said.
